subject: Innovox Assured platform (this repository)
assessor: Self-assessment by the build team. Not independent.

assessments.rationale: Assessor Console and the separation-of-duties rule are not built; no assessment process is operating yet.
The caller's credentials are never forwarded upstream (adversarial corpus), but token exchange to scoped downstream tokens is not implemented.

Outputs are size-limited and every string is scanned for injection phrasing, hidden characters, private keys and configured classification markings, then blocked or flagged per policy. Residual risk: the scan is pattern-based, so paraphrased or encoded injections pass (recorded as known gaps in the adversarial corpus). A classifier-based inspector is planned.
No human-approval hold for high-impact tools.
No runtime controller; services are not yet deployed into a sandbox by the platform.
The gateway denies a digest mismatch (tested), but the running digest comes from configuration rather than being attested by the runtime.

Every event and signed checkpoint is written to an export sink as JSON lines, and a checkpoint held off the node detects truncation and rewritten history. The gateway writes the export to a file for the customer's log forwarder; a direct SIEM transport is deployment-specific.
Node state records every accepted certified version (tested), but there is no inventory API or link to what is actually running.

This report measures the platform controls. The service controls cannot yet be run against Innovox's own images because the pipeline is not built. The code has no third-party dependencies, so its SBOM is the Go standard library only.
Work is test-first, vetted and traceable to plans, and was independently reviewed by an AI reviewer with findings fixed test-first. Human code review has not yet taken place.
assessments.evidence: docs/superpowers/plans; PR #1 description and review findings

assessments.rationale: One signer key signs both certificates and feeds, the root is a single key, and there is no root rotation (design review C1, T1).
The gateway implements the MCP revision before 2026-07-28: it handles initialize and ping and denies server/discover (design review C3, T5).
The gateway serves plain HTTP with static bearer tokens and calls services over HTTP. Server timeouts are set (design review C7).
Listings are rebuilt from the signed feed on every load. Residual risk: swapping the whole state file for an older valid one is not detected; that needs a counter held outside the file.
